author: touropia
description:
Greece is a country where ancient history and everyday life seem closely intertwined. Whitewashed villages overlook the blue waters of the Aegean, centuries-old temples stand among olive groves, and rugged mountains rise above quiet valleys.
Across the country, the landscapes change considerably. The green islands of the Ionian Sea feel quite different from the sunbaked hills of the Cyclades, while the mountainous mainland reveals another side of Greece altogether.
And although famous places like Athens and Santorini attract visitors from around the world, smaller towns and remote islands have often preserved a quieter, more traditional way of life.
